message: Going to Ju'mah and great chow hall food. I (un)fondly remember veggies cooked to mush, one piece of fruit (if it wasn't canned peaches or pineapple), jello, pudding, dry cake. Sounds like your experience is rather amazing. To me you seem, at times, like a guy who has most of the answers. This experience demonstrates that most of the time we don't even know the questions. The definition of humility I love is "teachable".  Jeff says to me, "There is the stuff we know, the stuff we don't know, and the stuff we don't know that we don't know. The point is to minimize the stuff that we don't know we don't know." Keep up the good fight brother, insha'Allah.
